About SKM Super

Ceiling solutions that transform your space.

SKM Super Industries Limited focuses on ceiling boards and ceiling finishing materials for homeowners, retailers, contractors, builders and interior professionals across Bangladesh.

Our main priority is ceiling boards in stylish designs. We also offer related ceiling installation materials and net angles to help customers source essential ceiling products in one place.
